scripts.sync:static: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist/home,dist/settings,dist/verify-email,dist/profile | Out-Null; Copy-Item home/index.html dist/home/index.html -Force; Copy-Item settings/index.html dist/settings/index.html -Force; Copy-Item verify-email/index.html dist/verify-email/index.html -Force; Copy-Item profile/index.html dist/profile/index.html -Force"
scripts.build:exe: set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& npm run build && npm run sync:static && electron-builder --win --x64 --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
